name: Attentional Bias
definition: Attention selectively favors certain information while other relevant information is overlooked.
boundary: Distinguish selective attention from a later judgment that weights negative evidence more heavily.

source_variants.name: Attentional Bias (Dikkat yanlılığı)
source_variants.definition: Systematically giving some stimuli more attention than others.
